# Distribution 2000 Inc.

Distribution 2000 Inc. is a Warehousing and Storage company. Distribution 2000, together with our freight affiliate Starlite Services, provides end-to-end warehousing and transportation solutions for consumer packaged goods (cpg) customers, operating from our central location in the Chicagoland area. Distribution 2000 Inc. employs 28 people (+7.7% YoY, +2 people) and has an annual revenue of $23.2M, founded in 1995. Headquartered in Romeoville, Illinois, United States.

## About

At Distribution 2000, we excel in handling specialty foods and fast moving consumer packaged goods. 

Our sophisticated warehouse facilities serve a group of high profile brands in the specialty food market, including a number of well known organic, gourmet and artisan foods and consumer products. These high value brands use Distribution 2000 because our capabilities and services exactly fit their warehousing and distribution needs.

Because of our sharp focus on this niche market, we are able to offer our specialty food customers significant benefits. Our expertise in handling their products and our thorough understanding of their market, their distribution chain, their retailers and their end consumers means they enjoy considerable operational efficiencies working with Distribution 2000. We offer our customers multi channel distribution arrangements, including specialty food retailers, main stream retailers and alternative channel retailers, and we work with a wide network of specialty distributors throughout the country. 


Distribution 2000 make it our mission to ensure that fine foods are handled, stored and shipped with the care and attention they deserve. We specialize in organic food and product handling. We run an FDA registered food grade warehouse that is USDA National Organic Program (NOP) compliance audited by Oregon Tilth Certified Organic (OTCO). We are also a member of the Organic Trade Association.

# Warehousing 2000

Warehousing 2000 is a Warehousing company. Warehousing 200 is a supply chain specialist company based in Laois, Ireland. They offer competitive storage solutions and exclusive transport services. They have a central distribution center and GPS tracking installed in their fleet. They cover 32 counties in Ireland and provide reliable and cost-effective transport services. Warehousing 2000 employs 3 people, founded in 1996. Headquartered in Portlaoise, Leinster, Ireland.

## About

Warehousing 2000 is a family run business that was established in 1996 by Michael Kerry. 

Our storage capacity has grown from 20,000 sq. ft. to 200,000 sq. ft. of high quality fully insulated warehousing that it is today. Situated on a 13 acre site nestled in a rural landscape just outside Portlaoise, Co. Laois and just 5 minutes from exit 16 on the M7 motorway, it is centrally located to all parts of Ireland. 

Warehousing 2000 offers all its customers a professional, reliable and personal service, that installs trust and strengthens working business relationships.

The level of service provided to our customers can be tailored to suit any requirement, whether it is pick and pack, product re-work or stand-alone turn-key solutions, we take emphasis on keeping our cost base low thus ensuring our customers see true value for money. 

Since our incorporation in 1996 many of our current customers have stayed the course with us which is a testament to our professionalism and level of experience in the supply chain industry.

Warehousing 2000 is regarded highly in Ireland as one of the country’s foremost and trust worthy logistics providers.
